result.title: LEF-JEPA: Denoising-Trained Latent Energy Fields for Spatial Representation Learning
result.comment: 14 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables. Includes supplementary material
result.summary: A joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) that applies prediction supervision only at masked positions struggles to clearly capture object shapes and boundaries in its latent representations. We further observe that some existing methods improve spatial structure while also retaining rich variations in texture and color. However, preserving more low-level visual information does not necessarily make representations better suited to prediction and action. This raises a key question: how can we strengthen the spatial structure in latent representations that supports prediction and action without over-encoding these details? We introduce LEF-JEPA, which learns spatial structure through target-guided latent recovery and transfers this supervision to the visual encoder through a relative-energy constraint; the energy module is used only during pretraining and adds no inference overhead. To reduce the cost of energy optimization during pretraining, we further construct a conditional Ising Hamiltonian that allows low-energy-state search to be performed by specialized Ising solvers. On physical hardware, we validate the feasibility of achieving lower forward latency with fewer local updates. Under a unified CIFAR-10 pretraining and frozen-encoder evaluation protocol, both realizations outperform V-JEPA2.1 in image classification, foreground segmentation, and visual planning.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LEF-JEPA：在 JEPA 框架下用「目标引导的 latent 恢复」配合相对能量约束学习空间结构，并将监督转移到视觉编码器；能量模块仅用于预训练、不增加推理开销，还用条件 Ising 哈密顿量把低能量态搜索交给专用求解器以降低预训练成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文关注的「既要保留空间结构又不过度编码纹理颜色等低层细节」与 LVR 中视觉细节保留和信息坍缩的权衡直接相关，其仅训练期使用的外部约束可为 latent 状态监督与贡献分配提供可核查的借鉴线索，但本身不涉及多模态推理或推理期 latent 生成。
